executive_summary.headline: World-pillar hazards—low water on the Rhine, elevated energy and commodity costs, seismic alert in China—are driving AMBER despite stable supplier and macro signals.
executive_summary.next_step: Confirm whether Infineon and Jabil's sharp stock falls on 22 Oct (both 2–6% moves, unconfirmed cause) correlate with any supply disruption or funding stress; if neither surfaces in next 48 hours, treat as market noise.
executive_summary.context: Rhine waterway depths remain below thresholds at both Maxau and Kaub, constraining barge transport for automotive and chemical inputs. Brent crude, EU gas, and aluminium all trade well above one-year baselines, raising input costs across electronics and transport. A red earthquake alert in China adds near-term logistics risk. Supplier pillar has toggled between AMBER and GREEN twice in the past week but sits GREEN now; no actionable supplier signals are live.
